newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dlr, firms vs pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dlr, firms vs pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and firmed slightly against the pound on Tuesday reflecting international market trends, dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 21.2245 to the dollar from 21.19 on Monday, and at 35.8415 to the pound from 35.8615 on Monday.
Forex dealers said the dollar and the pound were strong on international markets despite mild readjustment in overnight international markets.
The central bank was seen selling dollars in the interbank forex market late Monday morning at the prevailing interbank rate, dealers said.
"Most of the commercial banks are having a shortage of dollars today despite the central bank's interventions last Friday and Monday," one dealer said.
